text:
maya: Quick status check — kernel perf sprint standup. TL;DR: microbatch merge ready, continuous-batching canary needs owners, KV warmup heuristic PR has perf regression on p99. Who can pick up canary rollout this week?

jordan: I can own the continuous-batching canary. Planning to run on staging cluster A Wed morning. Need a checklist for rollback and perf gates.

liam: On the kv-warmup PR (#PR-462) — saw a 7% p99 bump on long tails when enabled with default thresholds. Investigating. Assigning INF-2134.

sophia: I have bandwidth to help with rollback/observability. I'll add dashboard panels for prefix cache hit rate and kv-eviction count.

maya: Awesome. Jordan, please add canary PR link + target hosts. Sophia, can you wire up alerts (pager if p99 > 1200ms for 5m)?

jordan: PR here: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/511 — will target staging-A and staging-B, ~10% traffic. Rollout plan in PR description.

ops-bot: deploy-bot started deployment runtime/canary/2026-03-18 to staging-A at 2026-03-18T09:15Z :rocket:

liam: quick note: the kv-warmup change is toggled by `KV_WARMUP_WINDOW_MS`. Current prod default 30000. The regression disappears when set to 8000.

maya: Good find. Can you post a minimal repro and perf trace?

liam: attaching snippet:
```yaml
warmup:
  window_ms: 30000
  prefetch_limit: 64
```
Trace: long-tail heatmap shows spikes aligning with eviction churn.

sophia: Created dashboard (runtime/kv-warmup) and alert rule. Linking: https://grafana.redwood/runtime/d/kv-warmup

jordan: Canary traffic is live on staging-A. Monitoring panels look green so far. Will increase to 25% at 09:45 if no regressions.

maya: Ops: if p99 > 1200ms on staging-A revert to previous image and roll traffic back to 0%. Jordan/Sophia, coordinate.

devex: Heads-up — add a short blurb to the runbook for the canary so oncall knows the rollback command: `kubectl set image deploy/runtime runtime=ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:sha-abc123`

jordan: noted. I'll update runbook and ping oncall.

maya: Thanks everyone. Action items: jordan owns canary rollout, liam investigates kv-warmup thresholds (INF-2134), sophia wires dashboards/alerts, devex updates runbook. Re-check tomorrow EOD. :thumbsup:
